comment: The output jacks are numbered 1 to 9 on the panel but the code orders them differently, so the panel number and the port index do not match. Outputs 10, 11 and 12 are internal inverters of IN3 and are not placed on the panel. The three clock inputs read high at any voltage other than 0V, negative voltages included: XSEQ.cpp:145, 149 and 182 assign the jack's float straight to a bool. Lines 131 to 133 do build proper triggers that demand a full 10V, but lines 139 and 140 throw those results away before they are used, so the trigger path is dead code.
